name: Bearing protective device
summary: Supervises an abnormal condition at a machine bearing, often using temperature or mechanical sensing.
description: Supervises an abnormal condition at a machine bearing, often using temperature or mechanical sensing.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the bearing identity and sensor type. The associated drawing should trace the bearing alarm or machine trip destination; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the bearing identity and sensor type.
Trace the bearing alarm or machine trip destination.
drawingChecklist: Label the bearing identity and sensor type.
Cross-reference the bearing alarm or machine trip destination.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: Bearing protection is tied to a monitored bearing; winding thermal protection addresses a different equipment location.
